name: Kent City Plastics
old_description: CONTRACT MANUFACTURERS OF QUALITY BLOW MOLDED AND INJECTION MOLDED PLASTICS
about:
Kent City Plastics operates from Kent City, Michigan, where it has served as a niche producer of blow molded, injection molded, and lost-core molded plastic components for nearly two decades. The company traces its roots to injection mold tooling work in the 1990s, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been publicly shared.

The shop runs 60,000 square feet of manufacturing space supplemented by up to 75,000 square feet of warehousing. Its blow molding department handles extrusion and injection blow molding, producing parts from 30 to 128 ounces in materials such as ABS, TPE, HDPE, PP, LLDPE, LDPE, and HMW-HDPE, with the option to mold in metal or plastic inserts. Injection molding presses range from 85 to 500 tons and process thermoplastic and engineered resins including TPV, TPU, glass-filled nylon, polypropylene, PVDF, PTFE, and carbon fiber composites. A specialized lost-core process enables hollow parts with complex internal geometries in a single molding. The engineering team brings over 60 years of combined experience in CAD, tool design, and assembly systems, supported by Cimatron E 14.0 software and common CAD formats.

Kent City Plastics serves industrial, agricultural, recreational, automotive, packaging, and transportation markets, working primarily with OEM customers. References include Michigan Rubber Products and Pacific Floor Care, both of which cite the firm’s full-service tooling and design-to-delivery capabilities.

The company positions itself as a solutions-oriented supply partner, emphasizing its quality management system (ISO 2001:2015 certified), tool design expertise, and program management support as key differentiators.
